jobs_results.title: Cloud Expert with a focus on Azure and DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Job Description - Cloud Expert with a focus on Azure and DevOps (MER000338E)

Cloud Expert with a focus on Azure and DevOps Group : Mercedes-Benz Group AG

Description

As a Cloud Expert, you will be at the forefront of our organization's cloud computing strategy, playing a pivotal role in planning, designing, and implementing innovative cloud solutions.

Your expertise will guide the transformation of complex business requirements into efficient and scalable cloud strategies, ensuring the optimization and security of our cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining automated processes to enhance system performance and providing expert advice on cloud technologies and best practices.

Your role will involve active collaboration with various teams, including IT security, to ensure compliance and data protection, while also contributing to the continuous improvement of our cloud capabilities through training and certifications. You will be a key player in... driving our organization's success in a dynamic and rapidly evolving technological landscape.

Description of role and responsibilities
• Planning, designing, and implementing cloud solutions to improve technologies and customer experiences.
• Transforming business requirements into efficient cloud strategies.
• Maintaining and expanding existing cloud infrastructure.
• Developing automation processes for enhanced efficiency and performance in the cloud environment.
• Advising clients and teams on cloud technologies, best practices, and optimization opportunities.
• Collaborating with IT security teams for data security and compliance.
• Active in continuous training and certification in cloud technologies.
• Balancing operations and development work.
• Designing and delivering integrations as services, automating API-driven systems in agile delivery models.
• Building and developing modern hybrid cloud infrastructures and services.
• Setting up automated testing in CI/CD solutions.
• Responsibilities include configuration management, resource allocation, performance capacity optimization, managing compliance, and ensuring service-level agreements are met
Qualifications

Education degree &technical experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Technical knowledge/Accountabilities

· Design, implement, and maintain highly available and scalable cloud-based systems in Azure

· Analyzing business requirements and transforming them into efficient cloud strategies

· Advising clients and internal teams on cloud technologies, best practices, and optimization opportunities

· Collaborating with IT security teams to ensure data security and compliance

· Defining infrastructure as code with Terraform

· Development of reusable Terraform modules

· Managing code repositories and CI/CD pipelines

· Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues

· Develop and maintain documentation for system architecture, processes, and procedures

· Continuously evaluate and improve system architecture to ensure optimal performance and scalability

· Multiple certifications in cloud technologies (Azure Solution Architect, Azure DevOps Engineer, Azure Administrator etc.) are highly regarded.

· Experience in a similar role, showcasing hands-on expertise in cloud solutions

· In-depth knowledge of Terraform, Github

· Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, TCP/IP, and load balancing

· Good knowledge of configuring and maintaining Linux and Windows servers

· Experienced in creating and managing Azure Data Factories for data integration with integration runtimes

· Familiarity with programming/script languageslike Python, Bash, PowerShell, Azure CLI etc.

· Knowledge of configuring DNS and network settings

· Knowledge of implementing monitoring solutions like Azure Monitor, Application Insights, DataDog, Grafana, Icinga

· Demonstrated ability in root cause analysis, investigation, diagnosis, and reporting

· Fundamental Knowledge in ITIL, SCRUM, KanBan and DevOps principles

· Solid understanding of containerization principles with Docker and Kubernetes with hands-on experience

Reading, writing and fluent conversation

Other Language

German is desirable: Reading, writing and conversation helpful.

Other Preferences

In addition to technical expertise, the ideal candidate should possess a set of vital soft skills for the role, including agility to swiftly adapt to evolving situations, a strong sense of empowerment, fostering trust and inspiration, a co-creative mindset that thrives on collaborative innovation, a relentless drive to excel and achieve success, unwavering customer orientation aimed at continually delighting our clients, a deep-rooted sense of purpose, a pioneering spirit that embraces innovation, and a commitment to continuous learning to stay at the forefront of industry advancements.

All these skills are included as People Principles in the Mercedes-Benz career path for our continuous development
Organization
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Key Roles and Responsibilities :
• Work closely with Platform Specialists to receive detailed business / user requirement specifications that identify the goals of the program
• Assist with the preparation of a technical requirements document, including systems and flowcharts that diagrammatically show how the information will flow through the computer and its peripheral or related equipment
• Analyse business requirements and ensure that the designed solution meets those requirements
• Transform the detailed requirements into a complete, detailed systems design document that focuses on how to deliver the required functionality
• Perform proof of concept if required
• Compile detailed technical specifications based on their designs for developers or IT Programmers to implement
• Convert a design into a complete information system. This includes acquiring and installing the systems environment, creating and testing databases, preparing test case procedures, preparing test files... coding, compiling, refining programs, and performing test readiness review and procurement activities
• Ensure that throughout the development phase, the process is documented including the development procedures for application use and security
• Oversee the testing of the program prior to its deployment and release
• Examine any program errors in logic and data and make the necessary recommendations to correct the program as required and / or escalate the problem accordingly
• Works with the required teams to assist with the installation and deployment of the application
• Assist with implementation preparation and implementation of the solution into a production environment
• Assist with the resolution of any problems identified in the integration and test phases
• Support all the code sets and implementations that have been implemented in production in accordance with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for the business
• Write and distribute the task descriptions in a production environment to operate and maintain the solution that has been designed and implemented
• Assist with post-implementation process reviews

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes :
• Expert knowledge on multi-technology application design best practices which enable them to act as trusted advisors to internal clients on optimal application designs
• Ability to take holistic views of application environments, including hardware platforms, applications, databases, operating systems, and storage
• Ability to work with abstract concepts and have sound problem solving and analytical skills
• Strong people interaction and collaboration capability
• Deep technical understanding of development and platform engineering
• Excellent client-centricity with the ability to focus on business outcomes
• Highly Organized and planned individual
• Self-starter and self-managed
• Strategic ability to define the technical direction in the portfolio of products including technical strategies and plans and execution plans
• Strong stakeholder and relationship management
• Excellent communication skills to effectively interact with a variety of stakeholders, including the technical teams and clients
• Ability to demonstrate impeccable attention to detail and work well within a team environment
• Good knowledge of project management principles to ensure that projects with clients are executed accordingly
• Ability to continuously contribute to the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to the improvement of current methodologies, processes, and tools
• Expert knowledge on design, implement, and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI / CD) pipelines to automate the software build, test, and deployment processes.
• Expert knowledge and experience with deployment and release management across environments.
• Expert knowledge of Automation tooling and source code repositories.
• Expert knowledge of continuous improvement and performance optimisation.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications :
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology or related
• Relevant DevOps certification
• Agile related certification
• understanding and certification of cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Knowledge and certification of scripting and programming languages (e.g., Bash, Python, Ruby).

Required Experience :
• Demonstrated years of experience deploying software solutions to clients in an outsourced or similar IT environment
• Demonstrated experience working in a multi-team environment across multiple geographies
• Programming / development experience including Agile processes such as SCRUM, KANBAN

Skills Summary

Automation Scripting, CI / CD, Cloud Platform, Communication, Container Orchestration, Cross-Team Collaboration, Security Compliance

What will make you a good fit for the role?

Workplace type : Remote Working

Remote Working

Equal Opportunity Employer

NTT is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

We do not discriminate based on age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, veteran status, or other protected category

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Since its foundation in 1925, the DEKRA promise has been to ensure the safety of human interaction with technology and the environment. DEKRA achieved revenues of around €3.1 billion in 2017. The company currently employs around 47,000 people in more than 50 countries on all five continents.

We have a clear and ambitious vision of the future. The vision for our 100th birthday in 2025 is to see DEKRA as the global partner for a safe world.
An exciting opportunity has arisen in our DIGITAL & PS Division. This area is to focus on tech competencies and drive digital innovation to help leading DEKRA into a successful future.

We are currently looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to strengthen our DIGITAL & PS area.

Qualifications:

Tasks/Responsabilities:
• Deployment of infrastructure in production environments.
• Design, implementation, and maintenance of internal continuous integration infrastructure.
• Implementation of monitoring systems in clients.
• Collaboration in the search for... new solutions for the continuous improvement of internal and external infrastructure and processes.

Your Profile:
• Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or similar.
• At least 1-3 years of experience in DevOps.
• Experience in infrastructure design and development as code.
• In-depth knowledge of deployment automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Chef.
• Experience in system monitoring and maintenance.
• Demostrable experience in the installation and maintenance of container orchestration systems, such as Kubernetes or similar distributions.
• Knowledge in virtualization systems such as Proxmox, VMware, or OpenStack.
• Basic knowledge in networks.
• Passion for automation and continuous improvement of processes.
• Strong communication skills and team work skills.

Other Info:
• Where’s the position based? Málaga or Madrid.

We offer you an excellent opportunity to grow and develop your career in a leading multinational organization. For more information about us or what we do, visit
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Internal Job Description
DevOps Engineer
Flexible location across Europe, home based
Who are we?
We are the creators of ClinSpark®, the world's first CDISC ODM certified Phase I eSource and clinical trial automation system. ClinSpark (now known as 'IQVIA Clinical eSource) improves the speed, quality and transparency of clinical research. We support a large and growing set of device integrations, enabling data collected from trial subjects, both onsite and remote, to be immediately available for review by study teams and the sponsor.
We're part of IQVIA - a world leader in using data, technology, advanced analytics, and expertise to help customers drive healthcare - and human health - forward.
Learn more here: IQVIA Clinical eSource Platform - IQVIA (https://www.iqvia.com/solutions/research-and-development/clinical-trials/clinical-trial-services-connected-devices/iqvia-clinical-esource-platform)
About you
- You find joy in helping your customers (biopharmaceutical, clinical research... organizations) who are doing important work.
- Creative thinker who strives to solve The Larger Problem when presented with a specific issue.
- Hungry to learn, self motivated, persistent, and detail oriented.
- Strong DevOps and Cloud technologies background. You should love building the tools to support software, collaborating with a cross-functional development team, and applying your creativity and focus.
- We care lots about your real world experience and less about years in industry or titles held.
About the role
- You'll be part of a very tight, highly professional team comprised of domain experts, former clinical research practitioners and engineers tackling all aspects of our business and operations.
- This position is responsible for designing, implementing and supporting technologies that underpin the ClinSpark platform. You'll help to create and manage standardised software development environments, driving improvements to our Developer Experience. For our customer production environments, you'll contribute to automating systems for deployment, monitoring and fault tolerance. You'll be directly engaged with customers on technical implementation questions, as well as troubleshooting their issues.
- Experience and familiarity with Cloud Platforms (preferably Amazon Web Services), Monitoring platforms (preferably Datadog), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, Fluxcd, Helm etc.), CI/CD (BitBucket, Gitlab, Github) are a must.
- This position is fully remote, although, candidates in the UK or EU timezones will be at an advantage.
Requirements
- Bachelors degree computer science, comparable field, or relevant work experience.
- Five (5) years related experience in DevOps, Cloud etc.
- Experience with clinical trials, core labs or medical devices is a plus.
Does this description fit you and do you want to learn more about the actual job? Reach out and talk to us!
What can we do for you?
You will become part of a distributed team, working in a remote capacity. This approach offers all of us a great deal of freedom and flexibility. We want you to figure out your own work-life balance. Family matters to us. You will receive a competitive salary package.
Are you interested in this position or you know somebody who could be interested, please let us know as soon as possible.
Working in the ClinSpark team can be challenging, it is certainly never boring, but above all, it is incredibly rewarding.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. We believe in pushing the boundaries of human science and data science to make the biggest impact possible - to help our customers create a healthier world. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
EEO Minorities/Females/Protected Veterans/Disabled

jobs_results.title: Business Analytics DevOps
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Talan is an international advisory group on innovation and transformation through technology, with 5000 employees, and a turnover of 600M€.

We offer our customers a continuum of services to support you at each key stage of your organization's transformation, with 4 main activities:
• CONSULTING in management and innovation : supporting business, managerial, cultural, and technological transformations.
• DATA & TECHNOLOGY to implement major transformation projects.
• CLOUD & APPLICATION SERVICES to build or integrate software solutions.
• SERVICE CENTERS of EXCELLENCE to support the latter through technology, innovation, agility, sustainability of skills and cost optimization.

Talan accelerates it's clients' transformation through innovation and technology. By understanding their challenges, with our support, innovation, technology and data, we enable them to be more efficient and resilient.

We believe that only a human oriented-practice of technology will make... the new digital age an era of progress for all. Together let's commit!

Job Description

As a Business Analytics DevOps, you will play a crucial role in developing and deploying APIs, ensuring seamless operations and data management. You will utilize your expertise in Java/Spring, database access, and Kafka to enhance our systems. The ideal candidate should have a solid understanding of Agile methodologies, API development, and deployment processes.

What would you be doing?
• Develop and deploy APIs, following Agile methodologies (Scrum).
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient data access and management.
• Utilize Java/Spring, Kafka, and database access for system enhancement.
• Work with PostgreSQL, Elastic, and other desired data sources.
• Implement event-driven development with Kafka or similar technologies.
• Maintain and optimize continuous integration tools, preferably Github.
• Explore and implement data transformations in Datalake.
• Utilize data analysis tools such as Power BI, Grafana, etc., for insights.

Qualifications

What are we looking for?
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Proven experience in API development and deployment.
• Proficiency in Java/Spring, Kafka, and SQL.
• Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Elastic, and other desired data sources.
• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum).

jobs_results.title: Back-end Web Developer + DevOps
jobs_results.description:
About Visca Web

At Visca Web we operate in the exciting and highly competitive online sports betting industry and our top objective is to deliver new players to our partners worldwide (operators such as Bet365, William Hill...etc) through our websites.

Our friendly and ambitious team consists of around 20 people in our Barcelona office. We all know each other’s names and being part of Visca Web is a great opportunity to make a noticeable impact.

We pride ourselves on having a truly international team (9 different nationalities) which is organized around tech development, product management, data analytics, SEO, Content production & Digital Marketing. Friendly startup feeling, but with structures and processes in place to grow fast.

Your Role:

We are looking for a Back-End Developer who can deliver quality software at a fast pace, as well as maintain and improve our AWS Infrastructure to help our websites and business grow. Our main sites are written in PHP. The ideal candidate... will also have experience with several of these platforms/tools/systems: WordPress, Agile methodologies, AWS (EC2, Lambda, RDS, CloudFront, S3, SES, etc…), Docker,, Kubernetes, Google Tag Manager, Google Cloud, Google APIs.

We anticipate the role split will be roughly 75% back-end development / 25% infrastructure-related.

Your main missions will revolve around:
• Websites and structure performance enhancements (PHP applications speed optimizations, speed up deployment, monitor code behaviours...)
• Managing hosting infrastructure (AWS), migrations, enhancements of the infrastructure.
• Implement performance monitoring systems and create dashboards to track KPIs.
• Support the front-end team develop features on our websites.
• Support the data team to maintain the infrastructure and suggest new ideas.

Required skills/experience/mindset
• Experience with modern PHP (OOP, Composer…).
• Solid knowledge of object-oriented programming, refactoring, etc.
• Ability to maintain a MySQL database.
• Server management (via AWS or other) or at least a desire to learn about server/AWS infrastructure
• Team player with a positive mindset, willing to find reliable solutions that fit the projects’ needs and their constraints.
• The ability to communicate in English.
• (Bonus) Knowledge and experience with Front-End technologies/software (ReactJS, gulp, webpack, Bootstrap).
• (Bonus) Experience with Kotlin to work (in pair) with our data analyst and data developer.

We have great benefits
• A stimulating work environment where autonomy & responsibility are key.
• The excitement to work in a booming full digital industry.
• International products (USA, Canada, Africa, Latin America).
• Annual personal training/conference budget.
• Wellness benefits (Private health insurance, on-site massages, healthy snacks…)
• Cool and bright office in the 22@ district of Poblenou (bike storage, rest room, play room…)
• Flexible working hours.

This position is a full-time one, based in our Barcelona office. Possession of a valid work-permit for Spain is a must

jobs_results.title: Principal Database DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
jobs_results.description:
The Position

About Roche Informatics

In Roche Informatics, we build on Roche's 125-year history as one of the world's largest biotech companies, globally recognized for providing transformative innovative solutions across major disease areas. We combine human capabilities with cutting-edge technological innovations to do now what our patients need next. Our commitment to our patients' needs motivates us to deliver technology that evolves the practice of medicine.

Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions.

About the position

As a Principal Database Platform Engineer at Roche, you'll step into a leadership role within our global IT department, championing innovation in an environment characterized by agility, a product-centric approach, and operational efficiency. With a worldwide scope, this position places you at the forefront of shaping, evolving and optimizing our advanced... database platforms, aligning seamlessly with our commitment to efficiency and excellence.

As a specialist in this capacity, you'll spearhead the design, implementation, and optimization of our hybrid database platforms. Serving as the linchpin in our global operations, these platforms are pivotal to our product-oriented initiatives. This role is uniquely compelling as it offers the opportunity to leverage a diverse range of technologies, with a focus on automation, open source solutions, and adherence to lean principles.

You'll partner with cross-functional teams worldwide, engaging closely with Product Managers, Architects, developers, operations specialists, and senior stakeholders in providing innovative solutions to challenges associated with database platform design, evolution and optimization.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Principal Database Reliability Engineer at Roche, where innovation meets reliability. We are in search of an accomplished and visionary leader to drive the evolution of our database systems and ensure unparalleled levels of availability, scalability, and performance.

Job responsibilities
• Drive innovation and establish technical direction to the whole lifecycle of new and existing platforms and services —from inception and design through deployment, operation and retirement by applying strong software engineering principles to build and manage large scale IT infrastructure platforms and services optimizing:
• services reliability, availability, scalability and performance and eliminating work through automation
• software development and deployment by abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure providing self-service tools and APIs for developers that allow code and ship software quickly
• Responsible for continuous improvement activities both in technical, teamwork, collaboration, strategy and processes areas.
• Lead the maintenance of services once they are live by designing metrics to measure and monitor availability, latency and overall system health.
• Proactively plan for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance and scalability to support the evolution of the internal platforms and systems
• Contributes to large initiatives aimed to optimize inter-related platforms for scalability and performance, ensuring that they can handle the increasing demands of applications.
• Lead as consultant the monitoring and resolution of incident/problems with platform operations, setting priorities and ensuring all areas collaborate in the resolution when required.
• Responsible for implementation and keeping updated cost, compliance and security best practices, ensuring that platforms and services meet the corresponding requirements
• Works closely with development teams to ensure that new features and changes are rolled out with reliability in mind bringing a broader and more strategic understanding of reliability that spans multiple facets of development.
• Provide direction and guidance and set up priorities, acting as senior analyst by transforming the customer and developers needs into specific requirements to be implemented by the product team or by other teams.
• Maintain in-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies within their technical, infrastructure area of responsibility to further the objectives of the team or department and ability to tackle complex and interdisciplinary issues.

Job Requirements
• Very strong and consistent interpersonal skills and proven strong oral and written communication skills.
• Consistently demonstrated customer & delivery focus.
• Proven strong hands-on technical skills in automation, infrastructure as code, logging, monitoring and observability, infrastructure configuration, scripting languages and applications.
• Wide experience working with Infrastructure systems internals, their availability, administration, capacity, configuration, scalability, performance and integrations.
• Wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing and CI/CD tools to:
• define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no operator or human intervention.
• implement and maintain Internal Developers Platforms (IDPs) that enable seamless software development and deployment.
• design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines enabling developers to easily build, test, and deploy their applications.
• Wide experience applying DepOps, design thinking and lean principles as well as prioritization and agile methodologies to evolve services offered to partners.
• Experience to continuously research, learn, innovate and share knowledge
• Strong ability to work effectively with team members and virtual teams from different locations and different cultural backgrounds.
• Demonstrated exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills with a focus on anticipating and addressing potential challenges in database platform design and implementation.
• Demonstrated ability to function independently without supervision and navigate ambiguity.

Technology Skills
• Technical Proficiency: Exhibit mastery in Open Source solutions (ie PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS Aurora) and noSQL (ie MongoDB, GraphDB, DocumentDB, Azure CosmosDB) as well as related technologies, showcasing your ability to navigate complexities and solve intricate problems associated with database platform design.
• Proven Leadership: Showcase a distinguished career in leading database platform engineering initiatives. Demonstrate a track record of driving transformative change and setting new benchmarks for excellence.
• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and/or GitOps plus required tooling (AWX, Rundeck, Ansible, Jenkins, Puppet, Chef or equivalent).
• Coding and scripting: Python, Perl, Rubby, JS, Go, SQL, GraphQL
• Mastering source code managers (Bitbucket, gitlab, github), CI/CD to automate software distribution
• Cloud native infrastructure: containerization, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform, Pulumi, public cloud cloud-native frameworks.
• Observability, monitoring and security tools such as LogicMonitor, CloudWatch, Open Tracing, and Grafana
• Public Cloud certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.
• Data mesh and data science experience and knowledge would be considered an asset.
• Public Cloud Solution Architect certifications on AWS, Azure and/ or Google Cloud Platform are desired.

Education / Years of experience
• 11-15 years of relevant work experience
• or 9-12 years with Bachelor’s degree
• or 6-9 years with Masters degree
• At least 8 years experience of working in one or more multinational work environments (e.g. healthcare industry experience is a plus) as a senior systems or software Engineer.

Ability to work across multiple time zones, including on-call and occasionally travel.

Who we are

At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs_results.description:
Work remotely anywhere in Spain - We are looking for Senior DevOps Engineers to worlds leading professional services company.

The client is one of the world's leading professional services companies, transforming clients' business, operating, and technology models for the digital era. This unique industry-based, consultative approach helps clients envision, build and run more innovative and efficient businesses.

Key Responsibilities of the job:
• As a Senior DevOps Engineer (5 to 7 years of experience) you will be responsible for implementing and supporting DevOps for application development which are based on different development technologies.
• You know the end-to-end DevOps with all three aspects of process, people and tools.
• As DevOps engineer you have to implement the processes like Agile Development, Continuous
• Integration, Continuous Deployment, Continuous Testing using Azure DevOps, Sonarqube.
• You have to support day-to-day service request for Azure DevOps... Sonarqube.
• You have to work with Microsoft to support Azure DevOps in certain scenarios. You will also be responsible for creating PoCs, pilot in Azure DevOps.
• You carry strong knowledge of software development using Agile methodologies like Kanban, Scrum.
• You will be interacting with client teams on regular basis while supporting DevOps.
• You also preferably have knowledge of some or all the legacy DevOps tools like JIRA, SVN, Jenkins, HPALM.

Skills & Experience:
• Strong knowledge of DevOps processes like Agile, planning, Continuous Integration, Continuous Development, Continuous Testing.
• Hands on experience to implement and support DevOps using Azure DevOps, Sonar, Balckduck.

Preferred Skills:
• Knowledge of software development using development language .Net,
• Knowledge of DevOps automation using any of the script based language like python, Shell, Perl etc.
• Self-motivated, excellent communication and interpersonal client facing skills.
• Fluent in English language
